title: Miyako: walking out of the tsunami's reach
about: Miyako, Iwate, within 3.2 km of its bay-side centre: the assumed tsunami (津波浸水想定) and the largest assumed river flood from the Hazard Map Portal (「ハザードマップポータルサイト」を加工して作成), the 52 designated emergency evacuation sites for tsunami (出典：国土地理院ウェブサイト), Overture Maps and GHS-POP. The plan brings the people of the tsunami zone out at 1.0 m/s leaving as in 2011 and leaving at once, and at 0.62 m/s, the mean observed in 2011, with the tall buildings that would serve as refuges; and ranks the roads to care under the largest assumed flood. Departure times and speeds are declared.
